spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation
 of the Four
 Days
 and
 Four Nights

---


**
¶2:** The first
 great state
 of
 illumin
ation is Divine
 Love itself
,
 the source
 of
 all
 wisdom,
 dwelling
 within
 the infinite
 states
 of its
 own life,
 in its
 living
 heaven
. The twelve full
nesses of this state
 are the twelve complete
 abund
ances of divine good proce
eding from that
 Love
. These are the first
 eman
ations that the Divine
 brought
 forth to manifest
 its
 own
 infinity
;
 and
 they were
 extended
 into
 every
 quarter
 of the
 heavenly
 life
, complete
 as to truth in every direction,
 proce
eding from the Divine presence.

**
¶3:** The second state of
 illumin
ation is the Divine
 Proceeding that mediates between the celest
ial and the
 natural, the
 one
 that
 dwells within
 doctrine
 as
 its
 vessel
. Its
 twelve full
nesses are the twelve pure
 affections for truth that the
 Divine
 Proceeding called
 forth from
 its
 own abundance
.


**¶4:** The third
 state of illumination is the sust
aining power of Divine
 Truth—
the great
 bearer
 that
 sur
passes all other bear
ers—
the
 one that uph
olds all states both
 interior
 and exterior. Its twelve fullnesses are
 the tru
ths derived from the Lord
 as
 Divine
 Truth in
 the
 celest
ial degree
, together
 with the truths derived from the Divine
 Proceeding in its operative
 power,
 which
 together
 up
hold all the bur
dens of the
 spiritual world
;
 together
 with the calling
-
forth of
 truth and the reception of truth
 by the
 will
,
 which are
 numbered
 among those
 ten companion
 truths.
 These are the twelve illumin
ated
 states
 of the third degree
 of
 wisdom
.

**¶5:** The
 fourth state of illumination is Divine
 Wisdom manifest
 in its fullness, dwelling
 within the communion
 of those
 who receive it. Its twelve fullnesses
 are the twelve wisdoms—
all the particular
 states of understanding
 that
 proceed
 from it
 as
 its
 lumin
ous complet
eness.

**¶7:**
 For
 just
 as four states
 of illumination from
 the Divine exist
,
 so also
 four states of spiritual
 darkness exist
.

**¶8:** The
 first state
 of darkness
 is the realm
 of fals
ity and evil in its
 origin
.
 It
 contains
 twelve particular
 falsities within
 itself, which are the dark
 states
 constit
uting it
. The twelve
 dark
nesses of this
 first state are the five fundamental
 evils of
 that
 realm,
 which p
oured forth from five
 sens
ory fall
acies; together
 with what
 dw
ells within those fundamental
 evils and
 their
 fac
ulties—
the five anim
ating evils that inhab
it those
 falsities.
 These are the twelve dark
nesses and anim
ating ev
ils of the original
 state of
 spiritual
 night
.

**¶9:** The
 second state of darkness is the self
-hood—
the proprium—
which
 forms and shapes all appearances
 of life
 from
 evil
. She
 has fashioned the
 entire
 domin
ion that
 rules
 within
 the real
ms of fals
ity. She
 has formed
 it into
 five fac
ulties of perception
:
 five
 belonging
 to the
 understanding
 and
 five
 belonging
 to the will,
 two
 in
 each domain
 of
 life;
 together with the self
-love and the
 conc
upiscence that d
well in the understanding and the
 will,
 infl
aming them toward
 conjunction
 with
 each
 other.
 These are the twelve anim
ating evils of this
 second state of
 darkness.

**¶10:**
 Indeed
 she
, this prop
rium—
the very
 thought and
 intention
 of spiritual
 death—gave
 to
 the ruling
 evil
 and
 all
 its powers the strength for combat
 and
 assault
 against the states
 of the
 Divine life. Yet that
 ruling
 evil was seized
.
 The
 Divine
 laid
 a provid
ential trap
 for
 it
 through the Lord
 as
 Divine
 Truth in
 the celestial degree.
 It
 was taken
 capt
ive and,
 through
 the powers of Divine
 order
, was brought up out
 of the realm
 of spiritual
 death and fixed
 throughout the whole
 created
 order
:
 in the five interior
 states
 of
 the higher
 mind
 and
 in
 the five exterior states of the lower mind
; together with the self
-love and the absence
 of charity that are the orig
inating principles—
the father
 and mother—of all evil desire
 and
 conc
upiscence.

**¶
11:** This is the second state of
 darkness,
 begotten from the first state
. The Divine laid
 a provid
ential trap for the
 prop
rium through the Lord as Divine Truth.
 She
 was brought up by the hand of the
 Divine
 Proceeding in
 its operative power, and was fixed
 within
 this composite order
 of
 creation—
distributed
 through interior
 and exterior states alike
. The interior
 aspect
 corresponds
 to the fac
ulties of understanding perv
erted; the exterior aspect corresponds to the
 faculties of will perverted.


**¶12:** The third state
 of darkness consists
 of the five
 domains
 of corpor
eal life: five
 belonging
 to the understanding and five belonging to the
 will,
 which were
 begotten from the spiritual
 evils ruling
 in
 the
 higher degrees
. These
 have
 descended
 into the natural and
 external mind, manif
esting in
 what is dev
oid of truth and in
 what holds
 only
 falsified truth;
 together with the self-love and the
 concupiscence dwelling
 within
 them
, which drives
 the
 false
 understanding
 and the evil
 will toward conjunction with
 one
 another.

**¶13:**
 The
 prop
rium herself
—
the very intention
 of
 spiritual death—is the mother of all
 these
 states
;
 for
 among
 them she bears
 the name "darkness
."
 The domains
 of corpor
eal understanding and corpor
eal will,
 together with their
 self
-love and conc
upiscence, constitute
 the
 twelve
 dark
ened
 states of this
 third degree
 of spiritual
 night
.
 And
 this
 third
 state
 of darkness,
 which
 re
igns in corpor
eal life, was itself
 begotten from the second state of darkness
; which the Divine Proceeding in
 its operative power fixed
 throughout the created
 order,
 in
 interior
 and exterior states alike,
 in the higher
 mind
 and the
 lower.


**¶14:** The fourth
 state of darkness is the ruling
 principle of evil itself
—the animating falsity that
 speaks through
 twelve
 particular
 ev
ils, twelve
 heresies.
 These
 are the spiritual
 expos
ures
 and
 dep
rivations—
the twelve
 governing
 appearances
 of the proprium arranged
 in count
erfeit order. They are the domin
ions upon
 which she
 sits
 ent
hroned;
 she who is made manifest
 as
 she forms
 and displays
 herself
 in the unregenerate self
.

**¶15:** And
 the
 particular
 states of this fourth darkness
—
which
 is the unregenerate self re
igning through
 its
 heresies—are the twelve anim
ating evils;
 the governing
 falsities of the unregenerate self
,
 which conf
use and obsc
ure the boundary
 between spiritual illumination and spiritual darkness,
 between
 the life
 of heaven
 and the state
 of spiritual
 death.

**¶16:**
 This is the fourth state of darkness—
all
 four
 having
 come
 forth
 one
 from another. Each
 has proceeded
 from the one
 before it, just as the states
 of illumination from
 the
 Divine each
 manif
ested the
 one that
 followed
.
 So also the states of darkness
:
 each
 arose
 out of the one that preceded it.


---

Note on
 "crucified in
 the universe" (
¶13):
* This
 image
 res
ists simple
 translation. My
 best
 reading
:
 the
 Divine Proceeding *
fixed* or *established* the
 prop
rium within
 the created
 order—
not destroying
 it but binding
 it into
 a framework
 where
 it
 could
 be
 subd
ued. The image
 corresponds
 to the
 subj
ug
ation and
 ordering
 of evil within
 the Grand
 Human
, where even
 hell
 is
 held
 in form
 by
 infl
ux
 from the
 Divine. The cruc
iform
 suggests
 a fixing
 at
 the intersection
 of interior
/
exterior and
 higher/lower—
the
 crossing
-
point of all
 spiritual
 axes
.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The first great day is the Father, the God of truth, the fir[st, who dwells in the m]idst the aeons of his greatness, in his [l]iving kingdom. The twelve hours of this great day are the twelve great rich Gods of greatness. These, who are the first evocations that he evoked (to mirror) his greatness, he spread out to the four climes, three by three before his face.
The second day is the Third Ambassador, the one who dwells in the light ship. His twelve hours are the twelve virgins that he evoked in his greatness.

[The third day is the Pillar of Glory, the great porter that is greater than] all [the po]rters; the one that supports all [the worlds], those above and those below. Its twelve hours are the five sons of the First Man; the five sons of the Living Spirit, who support all the weights of the universe; together with the summons and the obedience, which are counted to their ten brethren. These are the twelve light hours of the third day.
The fourth day is Jesus the Splendour who [dwells in] his church. His twelve hours are the twelve wisdoms, which are his [light] h[o]u[rs].
[Now hear concerning the four nights]: For just as four day[s ex]ist, s[o] too four nights exist.

The first night is the land of Darkness. It has twelve black [shadows] therein, which are its dark h[o]ur[s]. The twelve shadows of the first night are the five elements of the land of Darkness, [which] poured forth from its five sense organs; and [the fire and the lust] which [dwell] in its [fi]ve elements and its five [worlds]; the five [sp]irits that dwell in its elements [and its worlds]. These are the twelve shadows and spirits of the first night.

The second night is Matter, the sculptress [of all the forms of darkness, she] who has sculpted [every creature] and the entire ruling-power that is in the worl[ds of darkness]. She has fashioned it in five sense organs, five [male] and five female, two per world; together with the fire and the lust [that] dwell in men and women, inflaming [them] inward to one another. These are the twelve spirits of this second night.

Indeed she, this Matter, the thought of death, ga[ve] the King of the realms of Darkness and his powers strength for the war and the fight, against the aeons of greatness. Yet, he was caught! They laid a snare for him through the Fi[rst M]an. [He] was ta[ken] t[o captivity] through the powers [of the light. He] was brought up from the land of death and s[et in the parts ab]ove and below in the [whole] universe; in the five par[t]s in the heavens above, as well as the five [parts] in the earths below; together with the heat and the cold that are the father and the mother, their fire and their l[u]st.

This is the second night that is begotten from the first night. They laid a snare for her through the First M[a]n. She was brought up by the hand of the Living Spirit, and set in this composite univers[e. He spread] he[r], above and below. The [upper side is the sense] organs of males; the lower side [is the sense organs of] fe[mal]es.

The thir[d night is the five] worlds of flesh [. They are five] male, and five female; that were begotten from the powers [abo]ve. They have fallen upon the earth, being displayed in wh[at is d]ry and what is moist; together with the fire and the lust [that d]we[l]l in them, which drives them inward to one another.

[Mat]te[r] herself, the thought of death, is the [mother] of them all; as among them she is named 'the night'. [The worlds] of male and female fleshes, together with the fire and the l[ust], shall [be the] twelve hours of [the third] night. Again, [it] too, the third night that is in the worlds of fl[e]sh, was begotten from the second night; which the Living [Spir]it crucified in the uni[verse, and placed ab]ove and below in heaven [and in the earths beneath].

The fourth night is the law of Sin, which is the dark spirit who speaks in the twelve spirits, the twelve sects. They are the nakedne[ss]es, the twelve zodiacal signs of Matter. They are her thrones; she who is made public, as she sculpts and is displayed in the old man.

And, also, the hours of this fourth night that is the old man, who reigns in the sects, are the twelve e[vi]l spirits; the [ruling powers] of the old man, which [are the evil ones that reign in his sects, those that di]fferentiate the day and night [, and are the dark signs of] death.

This is the fourth night [; these are the four nights] that have come forth of one another. One has [come forth from the other,] just like the days of lig[ht, in which] they manifested one another. So als[o the nights of darkness,] they did arise out of one another.
